# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: 订单列表数据 (Type: array)
  - **data[].hasNext**: 是否有下一页. (Type: boolean)
  - **data[].lastId**: 本页最后的id. (Type: number)
  - **data[].list**: 订单列表. (Type: array)
    - **data[].list[].orderId**: 订单id. (Type: string)
    - **data[].list[].orderStatus**: 订单状态. (Type: integer)
    - **data[].list[].orderStatusTitle**: 订单状态主标题. (Type: string)
    - **data[].list[].totalCount**: 商品总数. (Type: integer)
    - **data[].list[].goods**: 订单商品. (Type: array)
- **message**: No comments found. (Type: string)
- **traceId**: No comments found. (Type: string)

## Original Response

{"success":true,"code":200,"message":"请求成功","datetime":"2026-10-09 18:17:29","traceId":"00000000000000000000000000000000","data":[{"hasNext":false,"lastId":0,"list":[]}]}
